Each of these has happened on a real page. The cause is usually one of three things: a token read from the wrong element, a value baked in at build time that should have been read at draw time, or a wrapper class missing from the markup.

## Charts and theme

**The chart has a pale blue plot area, or a white box, on the dark theme.**
The layout isn't themed. On a page rendered through the extension the Plotly patch merges [`layout()`](reference/plotting.qmd#layout) under every chart, so this means either Plotly loaded *after* `mathviz.js` (a hand-written `<script>` order; the extension gets it right) or the page passed `mathviz: {plotly: false}` and loads Plotly itself. Fix the order, or call `VM.plotting.installPlotlyPatch()` after Plotly is available.

**The axes and grid follow the toggle but the traces stay light-mode colored.**
Trace colors are values the page baked in; only re-running the cell changes them. Add the two-line pattern at the top of the page and read `chartColors.fn` in the chart cell -- [Theming: following the theme](theming.qmd#following-the-theme-in-a-chart).

**A translucent fill stays light-mode colored while its stroke lightens.**
An `rgba(...)` literal. Use `VM.plotting.alpha("ok", 0.2)` and make the cell depend on `chartColors`.

**The hover tooltip is a white box with unreadable text on the dark theme.**
Two possible causes. If it's your own token-reading code: you read from `document.documentElement`; the dark tokens are declared on selectors matching `<body>`, so `<html>` reports light values -- read from `document.body` ([why](theming.qmd#why-js-reads-from-body)). If it's a chart built outside the patch: Plotly derives a trace's tooltip background from the trace's own color unless the trace sets `hoverlabel`; set [`hoverLabel()`](reference/plotting.qmd#hoverLabel) on each trace, not only on the layout.

**A marker's white ring is invisible in dark mode / glaring in light mode.**
`line: {color: "white"}`. Use `chartColors.halo` -- white on light, the page background on dark.

**Colors read in a cell are correct after a toggle, but a stored array of colored things isn't.**
The storing cell ran before the toggle and doesn't depend on the theme. Add a bare `chartColors;` line at the top of it.

**The theme toggles but my `onThemeChange` callback sees the old colors.**
You aren't using `onThemeChange`. Quarto flips the body class and swaps the stylesheet as separate steps; a synchronous observer reads the outgoing theme. `onThemeChange` waits two frames for this reason.

**The whole chart rebuilds when the sidebar opens, or on some unrelated interaction.**
A body-class observer with no theme comparison. `onThemeChange` compares `themeName()` inside its deferred callback and fires only on a real change; use it rather than a bare `MutationObserver`.

**The dark palette leaks into the navbar on a light page.**
A dark selector that isn't root-scoped -- a bare `[data-bs-theme="dark"]`. Quarto sets that attribute on its `<nav>`. Match on `html`/`body` only, in both `tokens.css` and `configure({darkSelector})`.

**`Resize must be passed a displayed plot div element.`**
A `ResizeObserver` outliving its div: the cell re-ran, built a new div, and the old observer kept firing on the detached one. Use [`autoResize`](reference/plotting.qmd#autoResize), which disconnects itself.

**The y-axis title and tick labels are jammed against the container edge.**
`margin: {l: 0, r: 0, t: 0, b: 0}` in the page's layout, which defeats `automargin`. Remove it; `layout()` provides small non-zero margins that `automargin` grows.

**An unparseable formula draws an empty grid.**
Branch on the `null` from `makeFunction` and pass [`emptyState`](reference/plotting.qmd#emptyState) as the `annotations`.

**The chart is 0 px tall / doesn't appear.**
The graph div has no height. Give it `plotly-box-large` or a `style.height`, and call `autoResize` -- the div was built detached, so Plotly measured 0×0.

**Zoom in/out jumps too far; there's a box-select button I don't want.**
The patch isn't installed (see the first item). It replaces the modebar with 1.25× zoom steps and no select tools.

## Panels and controls

**The legend disappeared / appears as a thin strip.**
The legend cell isn't inside an `.ojs-chart-block`. Quarto's `.cell-output-display` is a scroll container that clips escaping descendants; the block's rules turn that off for the cells inside it.

**A floating panel I built is cut in half.**
Same clip. No `z-index` fixes it; only leaving the clip does. Render floating UI as a native `[popover]` (top layer), as the playback popover does.

**Two-column grid overflows the right edge by ~70 px.**
Observable Inputs' forms have a fixed `360px` width. The `ojs-panel` rules override it -- the controls aren't inside a panel.

**Labels wrap onto three lines above a slider.**
Observable's `120px` label column. Inside `.ojs-panel` or `.ojs-chart-controls` labels are freed; outside them they aren't.

**Doubled border and background around a panel.**
An `ojs-panel` nested inside another. Nest a bare `ojs-row`/`ojs-grid` div instead.

**An `Inputs.select()` doesn't stretch to fill its row.**
Deliberate: inside a panel the control sizes to its own option text (with a 12 em floor) rather than to the row, so it doesn't read as a full-width slab beside the compact fields next to it. The wrapping form still takes the row's width for layout. Set a width on the `<select>` itself to override.

**A slider has no play button.**
It isn't inside `.ojs-panel` or `.ojs-chart-controls`, or something above it has `data-vm-play="off"`, or it has no `<form>` ancestor (a raw `<input type="range">` outside Observable Inputs).

**The playback popover opens under the navbar / off the right edge.**
Shouldn't happen -- it clears `#quarto-header`, `.navbar.fixed-top` and the window edge. If your site's fixed header uses another selector, the panel may open under it; file an issue with the selector.

**`applyExampleParams` applies the first fields and then a later one snaps back.**
Field order: a field whose bounds depend on an earlier one (a step slider capped by "max") must come *after* it in `params`. Or: you called it from a cell reactive on a `<select>`, which fires twice per selection; call it from one DOM listener on a stable element.

**`applyExampleParams` loops forever / the page freezes with history-API throttling.**
`fieldSelectors` holds `viewof` references instead of selector strings. See [why](reference/ui.qmd#applyExampleParams).

**A table renders unstyled.**
`renderTable` emits Bootstrap classes (`table table-sm table-bordered`). On a non-Bootstrap page bring your own table styles or target `.ojs-table-container table`.

## Build and install

**`quarto add` says the extension isn't found, or a symlinked `_extensions/mathviz` isn't used.**
Quarto checks `isDirectory()` on the raw directory entry, so a symlink is skipped. Use `quarto add /path/to/mathviz --no-prompt`, which copies.

**`Version mismatch: package.json=… _extension.yml=… mathviz.lua=…`**
The build refuses to run until the three agree. Bump all three.

**CI fails with "dist/ is out of date".**
A change under `src/` without `npm run build`. Run it and commit `dist/` and `_extensions/mathviz/dist/`.

**`(intermediate value)(...) is not a function` on page load.**
Two source files concatenated without a `;` between them (`})(window)` followed by `(function` parses as a call). The build inserts the separator; this only appears if `dist/` was hand-edited or built another way.

**A new function isn't in `window.VM` in the browser.**
Its file isn't listed in `src/manifest.mjs` -- `npm test` fails with the name. Add it after anything it reads at load time.

**`npm test` fails with "documents … but exported …".**
The docs-coverage test: a `VM.*` member exists without a `### VM.<category>.<name>` heading in `docs/reference/<category>.qmd`, or a heading names something that doesn't exist. Add or fix the entry.
